Preferable manufacturer should participate. Participating traders/agents must provide authorization lett er issued by the OEM. Authorization letter should be tender/Bid specific. Bidders must submit valid authori zation letter containing the required information along with their offer failing which the offer is liable to be ignored. 2. For placement of order, the OEM [Principal Firm] directly or through authorized dealers shall have succe ssfully executed a contract for supply of Computer Printer to any Govt organization/PSU/P PP Project of min imum 10 percent of the advertised value of the bid [Bid Value – 32958.00] during previous 3 years. This pe riod of 3 years shall be counted with respect to date of tender closing. In this regard, Firms should submit a past performance document in the form of CRN/CRAC/R-NOTE/completion certificate issue d by compete nt authority of that Govt organization/PSU/PPP Project along with PO. Failure to submit documentary evide nce will imply that firm has no such performance and Railways reserves the right to disqualify the offer. In case tenderer participates as an authorized agent, then the past performance as required above shall be t hat of the principal, authorizing the agent. It may so happen that the agent has credentials of past supply f or a different Principal, but these will not be considered as performance for placing the order in case of cha nge of Principal. 3. Contract shall be governed by IRS conditions. 4. Material Transportation, handling and unloading is in the scope of supplier. .
